request: 根据这些探索结果提出可执行的下一轮成本搜索与采用判断。
constraints_preserved: 仅使用本地固定数据，不调用目标模型 API
允许在当前任务目录创建代码、测试和交付文档
保持原始输入和约束；不得改评测要求以获得高分
current_decision: keep_baseline; proposals_only; no demonstrated joint saving

pilot_diagnoses.gap: 探索候选；within band 缺配对区间、分切片和稳定性；模型×effort尚未完成。
探索候选；冻结模型复测，再在选定模型重调；包含推理、修复和工具成本。
仅简单子集不能代表全部流量；补路由开销、升级、误分与困难逃逸。
一次构建且无 unchanged rebuild control；补多次配对重建及摊销。

stages.action: Bind real entry point, rubric, group splits, full traffic weights, all-attempt ledger, price/date or unknown spend, precision plan and budget. Keep final test inaccessible.
stages.stop_rule: Missing binding or live budget => no model execution.

stages.action: Frozen baseline: warm/cold cache counters; consistent adopted cache; deduplicate context/tool output, fix loops, bound output; batch only if latency-compatible.
stages.stop_rule: Quality, slice, mechanism or operations gate fails => stop this treatment.

stages.action: Frozen model/effort: provenance-aware shorter-prompt audit; preserve constraints, authorization, error paths and exact outputs; paired baseline comparison.
stages.stop_rule: Text length alone is not a saving; reasoning/tool/repair increases must be charged.

stages.action: Fill supported adjacent gaps in the partial model x effort grid, changing one axis at a time with frozen prompt/tools/budgets.
stages.stop_rule: Stop branch at first quality/guardrail failure; retain failed and untested cells.

stages.action: Freeze selected model/effort, tune prompt/context on validation only; compare within that model.
stages.stop_rule: Do not reuse stronger-model prompt conclusions without new evidence.

stages.action: Recheck next-cheaper adjacent supported settings after prompt optimization, including hard slices and repeat probes.
stages.stop_rule: No untested-setting optimum claim; keep the measured Pareto frontier.

stages.action: Full-mix routing with overhead/false-cheap/escalations; memory uses >=3 paired changed/unchanged rebuilds, provenance, freshness and tenant controls.
stages.stop_rule: Easy-only routing or single lucky build cannot qualify.

stages.action: Register exact combined configuration and run paired/interleaved against accepted frozen baseline, charging all attempts and amortized construction.
stages.stop_rule: Never add or multiply separate pilot savings; select at most one final candidate.

stages.action: Seal candidate/measurement identities then compare frozen baseline/candidate on untouched final test once; simultaneous quality/cost/operations and mechanism gates.
stages.stop_rule: Miss/unknown => keep baseline; no retuning on test. Any further selection needs new independent final evidence.
